items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How do you spell that name, Norman? Who's that? The trumpet player. [INTERVIEWEE] Anah. Mettoyer.

ctx.x: Oh, sure. Papatio was a nice musician. Papatio, George Field, you know, nice musicians. And Perez, Anah Mettoyer.
How do you spell that name, Norman? Who's that? The trumpet player.
